description.zh:
贝爷在一次极端荒野求生拍摄中误闯入一道不稳定的时空裂隙，被抛入霓虹闪烁的赛博底层。凭借多年野外生存的本能与直觉——辨风向、追痕迹、拆旧物——他在废墟与暗巷里摸到了不少被世人遗忘的「宝贝」。如今他在底层盘下一家当铺，把求生技巧变成了识货眼光；旧背包仍挂在肩上，手电与扫描仪是新的「指南针」，战斗匕首是最后的保险。

【特性】
· 拾荒与当铺经营工具一套
· 探险识货装备齐全
· 随身求生物资与应急补给
· 开局现金 -400
· 仅「一贫如洗」起始可选
description.en:
During an extreme wilderness survival shoot, Bear Grylls stumbled into an unstable spacetime rift and was hurled into the neon-lit underbelly of a cyberpunk world. Drawing on years of fieldcraft—reading terrain, tracking signs, stripping salvage—he turned instinct into an eye for forgotten treasures. Now he runs a pawn shop in the slums, where survival skills meet street-smart appraisal. The old backpack still rides his shoulders; flashlight and scanner are his new compass; the combat knife is his last resort.

【Features】
· Scavenger and pawn-shop toolkit
· Exploration and appraisal gear
· Survival supplies and emergency rations
· Begin with 400 less cash
· Rock Bottom start only
